title: Retention, holds and erasure
acceptance_scenarios: Use boundary-date fixtures for each approved class; refuse deletion of held/retained records and whole tenants. Prove lawful purge, attachment removal, backup expiry and restore suppression.
evidence_after_implementation: A05-retention-hold-tests.json; approved-schedule.pdf; disposal-approval.pdf; scoped-erasure-report.pdf; backup-expiry and restore-suppression results.
manual_acceptance: Custodian/DPO approves trigger dates, exceptions and custody. Demonstrate configuration, boundary tests and sustainable contracts; do not claim a test proves decades of elapsed storage or physical erasure of unverified media.
history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
implemented_controls: Company-scoped retention/legal holds stop linked healthcare-record and patient deletion. Released holds retain history. Tenant closure requires an explicit custodian approval reference and no active hold. No automatic clinical destruction is enabled.
remaining_actions: Custodian/legal team must approve retention classes, schedule, exceptions, archive custody and each destruction procedure. Final clinical notes remain locked; a reviewed statutory disposition service is future work if required.
